payload.title: The file-name token rule lists only singular words, so a plural base name such as docs/db/19-improvement-specs.md is not a record and that one dated snapshot document emits 30 of the adapter's 172 findings on the real tree
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/doc-staleness-adapter.ts:335 (RECORD_DIR_SEGMENTS spells the plurals reviews and audits)
tools/aria-adapters/doc-staleness-adapter.ts:350-360 (RECORD_NAME_TOKENS spells only the singulars report, review, audit, verification, spec, plan, inventory, retro, plus findings)
tools/aria-adapters/doc-staleness-adapter.ts:397-401 (the base name is split on separators and each token must equal a listed word, so specs never matches spec)
docs/db/19-improvement-specs.md:1-5 (a generated document dated 2026-03-18 with Status Ready for implementation agents)
docs/db/19-improvement-specs.md:162 (file table of the cron services as of 2026-03-18; feeding-cron.service.ts no longer exists)
docs/db/19-improvement-specs.md:277-282 (six tenant-schema.middleware.ts paths that no longer exist)
tools/aria-adapters/doc-staleness-adapter.test.ts:468-482 (the file-name pin enumerates only the nine singular tokens; no plural base name is pinned either way)
payload.rule_violated: DOCROLES SPEC ruling 2 (a base name holding spec, plan, report and the other tokens is a point-in-time record) and the single-owner rule: the review and audit vocabulary has two spellings (plural for directories, singular for names) with no pin that relates them.
payload.notes: Calling isPointInTimeRecord on docs/db/19-improvement-specs.md returns false, while docs/db/19-improvement-spec.md, docs/db/18-final-review-report.md and the other numbered documents of that series return true. The document is scanned as live, none of its roles apply to the file tables, and a replay of the adapter functions over a81bfa2d6 emits 30 findings for it (17 percent of all 172), and by the package's own ruling that a spec is a record these are history, not staleness. They go to the judges as false claims and lower the precision that ARIA-HIGH-212 measures. docs/guides/reviews.md is the same class (live although named for a review). Close condition: Match each record token and its plural from one list that RECORD_DIR_SEGMENTS also reads, and pin plural base names in the file-name scenario of doc-staleness-adapter.test.ts; proof is isPointInTimeRecord true for docs/db/19-improvement-specs.md and the real-tree replay dropping 172 to 142 findings with recordDocs up by one. Verified at origin/main a81bfa2d6.
